posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina Kaif wished Rohit Shetty on his birthday amid ongoing rift rumours, while fans continue to buzz about her life with Vicky Kaushal and their family updates from London.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit Dosanjh made history as the first Indian artist to sell out two consecutive nights at Madison Square Garden and debuted on The Tonight Show with Jimmy Fallon. His upcoming film 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' with Imtiaz Ali and AR Rahman is generating major buzz.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia Bhatt turned heads at Cannes 2026 and is gearing up for her action-packed role in YRF's 'Alpha' alongside Sharvari. She continues to dominate headlines with her versatile film choices and fashion statements.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka Chopra is making her grand return to Indian cinema in SS Rajamouli's 'Varanasi' alongside Mahesh Babu, set for an April 2027 release. She's also been sharing sweet family moments with daughter Malti and husband Nick Jonas.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: Shah Rukh Khan reunites with Anil Kapoor, Rani Mukerji, and Jackie Shroff in the much-anticipated 'King,' featuring a Ranveer Singh cameo. Buzz is also building around a potential 'Main Hoon Na 2' with director Farah Khan.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena Kapoor Khan celebrated son Taimur's Taekwondo achievement and went viral with her pool party photos. She continues to charm fans with her candid family moments and effortless style.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha Kapoor made headlines with her new Lamborghini purchase and became India's second most-followed actress on Instagram, crossing 70 million followers. She remains one of Bollywood's most beloved social media stars.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika Padukone is using a body double for action sequences in Atlee's 'Raka' and SRK's 'King' as she balances her pregnancy with a packed production schedule. She also made a stunning Cannes 2026 appearance.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer Singh faces an FWICE non-cooperation directive over his Don 3 exit, with Farhan Akhtar seeking ₹45 crore in reimbursement. Meanwhile, his blockbuster 'Dhurandhar 2' is approaching ₹1,150 crore at the domestic box office.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan stole the spotlight at Cannes 2026 with a stunning white pantsuit blending modern tailoring and old Hollywood glamour. A viral video of daughter Aaradhya gazing adoringly at her during an autograph session melted hearts worldwide.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika Mandanna is promoting 'Cocktail 2' with Shahid Kapoor, with the romantic track 'Tujhko' winning hearts. She's also been announced as Popeyes India's brand ambassador and is set to star in the fierce action film 'Mysaa.'

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha Ruth Prabhu dropped the action-packed trailer for 'Maa Inti Bangaaram,' produced under her own banner Tralala Moving Pictures, releasing June 19. The film sees her in a fierce, never-before-seen avatar.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's next big project 'Raka' with director Atlee and Deepika Padukone is in active production, with major action sequences being filmed. Post Pushpa 2's massive success, all eyes are on his next move.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's highly anticipated 'Peddi' drops the energetic dance track 'Hellallallo' with Janhvi Kapoor and Shruti Haasan, composed by AR Rahman. The film releases worldwide on June 4 with a runtime-breaking 3 hours 9 minutes.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's 'Dragon' with director Prashanth Neel has locked a massive ₹55 crore North America and UK theatrical deal ahead of its 2026 release. He's also simultaneously filming 'War 2' for a Sankranthi release.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi Kapoor is in full promotional mode for 'Peddi' alongside Ram Charan, with the new song 'Hellallallo' setting the internet on fire. The film, featuring AR Rahman's music, hits theaters worldwide on June 4.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya Panday's 'Chand Mera Dil' with Lakshya is resonating with youth audiences after its theatrical debut, earning a BOGO push to boost collections. She's also making headlines after being trolled for a Bharatnatyam dance sequence in the film.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara Advani and Sidharth Malhotra have welcomed their baby girl and requested privacy during this special time. The couple is embracing new parenthood while fans shower them with love and congratulations.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik Roshan has confirmed 'Krrish 4' is in the works, thrilling fans of the superhero franchise. Co-star Ameesha Patel shared a nostalgic throwback from 'Kaho Naa Pyaar Hai,' celebrating their enduring Bollywood friendship.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun Dhawan teams up with dad David Dhawan for 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai,' a classic comedy set for June 5 release. The father-son duo revive the Judwaa and Mujhse Shaadi Karogi brand of Bollywood humor.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya Ghoshal continues to be one of India's most beloved playback singers, with recent family moments and her son Devyaan bringing joy to fans. She remains a powerhouse voice behind Bollywood's biggest hits.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman mesmerized audiences at a live concert in Bhopal for the 'Peddi' promotions and revealed he's collaborating with Hans Zimmer on the ₹4,000 crore 'Ramayana' starring Ranbir Kapoor.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Thalapathy Vijay's final film 'Jana Nayagan' is confirmed for a June 19 release, timed near his birthday. The film faces CBFC clearance hurdles, while his ongoing divorce proceedings with Sangeetha Sornalingam continue to make headlines.
